b1-unit-45.45.1 A day out with Carol:
Carol: Thanks for showing me around today. You don't usually work on Wednesdays, do you?
Danny: No, Wednesday is my day off. And Ana asked me to look after you, didn't she?
Carol: She did! She worries about me so much. I'm a grown woman! Anyway, Bruno was supposed to come too, wasn't he?
Danny: Yes, but he's in bed with the flu. I sent him a message this morning: "Get well soon!"
Carol: What a shame. Oh, these sandwiches are huge, aren't they?
Danny: They are! Careful, it's... oh no! Sorry, I spilled some juice on your bag.
Carol: Don't worry. It doesn't matter. It's an old bag.
Danny: Can I ask you a question?
Carol: Sure, go ahead.
Danny: You've been studying Portuguese for a long time, haven't you? You read the whole menu!
Carol: Only six months! I've been teaching myself with an app.
Danny: No way! Well done!
Carol: Thanks! Oh no... where's my phone? I can't find my phone!
Danny: Calm down. You put it in your jacket, didn't you?
Carol: Oh... yes, here it is. Sorry!
Danny: And on Saturday you're going to the beach with Ana, aren't you?
Carol: Yes! And next week Marcos is taking us to Paraty for two days.
Danny: Lucky you! Have fun! And when do you fly back to Orlando?
Carol: Next Friday.
Danny: Then I'll say it now: have a good trip! It's a long flight, isn't it?
Carol: Very long. But this time I'll sleep... unless the man next to me snores again!
